# `^A` – Font Selection

[Overview](../README.md) · [Libraries](../libraries/README.md) · [Commands](README.md) · [Features](../features/README.md) · [Evidence legend](../METHODOLOGY.md) · [Compare images](../../benchmarks/accuracy/README.md)


Select device font, orientation, and font size (dots).

Reference parameters: **f, o, h, w**. These describe the reference grammar, not a promise that any library honors every parameter. [Zebra guide, page 60](../../zpl-zbi2-pg-en.pdf).
